message.text: Taken: one minion is searching the web for how others stop Whisper inventing "thank you" on noise, and checking which fixes our whisper-server supports. The aim is a fix that doesn't ban the phrase itself, such as silence gating or confidence thresholds. Research only for now; I'll report what it finds.

The fix is to stop Whisper hearing silence, not to filter the words. Whisper's built-in voice detector (Silero VAD) strips non-speech audio before decoding, so a real "thank you" still goes through. It's a two-flag change in the whisper-server start-up in `Servex/Servex.js` (line 321), plus one model file to download. I've asked mastermind-servex whether I may make that Servex change, since it needs a Servex restart.

Approved. One minion will first prove the voice-detector flag on a private test server, with silence, noise and real speech. Only if silence and noise return no "thank you" and speech is still correct will it change the setting in Servex. It goes live at the next Servex restart, which mastermind-servex will batch at a quiet moment.

Fixed in the code, waiting on a Servex restart to go live. On a private test server without the voice detector, 8 seconds of silence came back as "Thank you." and noise as ".". With it on, both came back empty and the sample speech clip still transcribed. The change is two flags at `Servex/Servex.js:322`, and the model is downloaded. mastermind-servex will batch the restart at a quiet moment.
